valuationTarget.durableOperatingTarget: 40M-60M ARR category leader or equivalent strategic outcome

hypotheses.claim: Enterprises will pay six-figure annual contracts to let AI agents perform engineering changes under independent authority, evidence and recovery.
hypotheses.test: 15 buyer interviews, 3 design partners, 2 paid pilots
hypotheses.killCriteria: buyers consistently classify the product as bundled tooling or refuse paid real-repository pilots

hypotheses.claim: Chat plus approval-by-exception can reduce human interaction steps by at least 70% without increasing unauthorized effects.
hypotheses.killCriteria: governance overhead equals or exceeds saved work
hypotheses.evidenceBoundary: 73.3% synthetic median step reduction is a contract/instrumentation result, not human validation or market proof.

hypotheses.claim: Action Passports and evidence closure materially reduce review and audit preparation effort.
hypotheses.test: measure reviewer and audit evidence time against current workflow
hypotheses.killCriteria: evidence package is not trusted or does not reduce effort

hypotheses.claim: Provider-neutral sovereign deployment creates material willingness to pay versus model- or cloud-native controls.
hypotheses.test: regulated and multi-provider customer interviews and pricing tests
hypotheses.killCriteria: target customers prefer bundled incumbent controls and assign no premium to independent authority

hypotheses.claim: Proof-carrying adaptive shortcuts reduce approvals, model calls, latency or cost while preserving the full assurance level.
hypotheses.test: external recurrent-workflow pilot measuring approvals, model calls, wall time and provider bill while preserving evidence closure
hypotheses.killCriteria: shortcut divergence or qualification cost exceeds the saved value

hypotheses.claim: AI-assisted construction can be converted into a diligence advantage through provenance, independent validation and reproducible evidence.
hypotheses.test: external code, license, security and maintainability review
hypotheses.killCriteria: critical code cannot be explained, maintained, licensed or independently reproduced

hypotheses.claim: Independent scanner federation and a verifiable signature supply chain reduce single-engine and poisoned-feed assurance risk without allowing unsafe majority voting.
hypotheses.test: live ClamAV/YARA federation with external signed feed chain, disagreement campaign and external operators
hypotheses.killCriteria: scanner diversity is nominal, disagreement policy increases unsafe acceptance, or feed governance cannot prevent rollback and poisoning

hypotheses.claim: Independent transparency witnesses and signed gossip materially reduce split-view and self-attested evidence risk for governed AI operations.
hypotheses.test: two external witness organizations on separate hosts cross-sign live scanner log checkpoints and detect an induced split-view
hypotheses.killCriteria: witnesses cannot remain operationally independent, gossip does not detect equivocation, or evidence cost exceeds buyer value

hypotheses.claim: A dual-custodian external key ceremony plus unanimous fresh witness gossip reduces operator-key and split-view risk without creating unsafe majority voting.
hypotheses.test: two external witness organizations and two scanner operators complete live ceremony rotation revocation and induced stale or missing witness campaigns
hypotheses.killCriteria: ceremony overhead prevents operation, role independence collapses, or all-active policy provides no buyer-valued risk reduction

hypotheses.claim: A policy-bound dependency planner with independent approval, canary rollback and retained generations reduces unsafe update risk without granting production authority.
hypotheses.test: repeat with independently sourced package bytes and separately administered non-production canary telemetry
hypotheses.killCriteria: candidate selection is not reproducible, approvals collapse to one operator, rollback misses its threshold, or retained generations cannot be restored

hypotheses.claim: Role-bound enrollment, revocable interruption and exact sealed transfer reduce ceremony substitution and replay risk without granting production authority.
hypotheses.test: repeat with sixteen independently administered role owners and twenty-two provider-backed external attestations
hypotheses.killCriteria: packages or challenges can be replayed, revocation can be bypassed, transfer bytes diverge, or local evidence can be relabeled as external
